## ---- THE K-12 CURRICULUM ROW THIS BASE NAMED IN Gap 367 AND NEVER PROBED ----
code-dot-org/code-dot-org
column2: Apache-2.0 WITH A PROPRIETARY-MATERIALS CARVE-OUT (payload, read in full)
column8: THE LARGEST EDUCATION CODEBASE THIS KB HAS LOCATED — 2.7x instructure/canvas-lms (78765), which p267 published as the largest. Commit figure read TWICE independently (repo page + tree/staging), both 215,796. Last commit 2026-10-17, merge 7995a55, PR #76166. SIDEBAR LICENSE LINK IS UNLABELLED — p267's signal, fired correctly. Payload: Apache-2.0 applies to "all source codes and assets, with the exception of Code.org's proprietary or licensed artwork, graphics, sounds, lectures, videos, logos, characters, fonts, etc. ('Proprietary Materials')", which "may not be used or distributed or accessed in any manner other than directly via Code.org's own web site, mobile applications, or social media channels ... without modification or embedding in another format."

column1: code-dot-org/code-dot-org#NOTICE
column8: NOTICE names the entertainment IP inside the curriculum: Minecraft (Microsoft), Star Wars (Disney/Lucasfilm), Frozen (Disney), Ice Age (20th Century Fox), Angry Birds (Rovio), Plants vs. Zombies (PopCap), The Amazing World of Gumball (Cartoon Network), The Bad Guys (DreamWorks). Also Font Awesome icons under the Font Awesome PRO licence, and the Geist font under SIL OFL. Code.org cannot sublicense these and neither can a studio.

column1: ## ---- THE THIRD MCP-ADDRESSABLE LMS: Google Classroom / Workspace for Education ----
adriasantacreu/google-classroom-mcp
column2: MIT (METADATA grade — package.json; sidebar shows NO licence; README states MIT)
column8: The most capable of the family: "46 fully implemented tools" over courses, assignments, grading, rosters and Drive. README IS IN ENGLISH — the author's Catalan name is NOT provenance and no country is stated. Metadata grade, so it is weaker evidence than every payload row here.

column1: Kimmahone/edu-workspace-mcp
column8: Google Workspace for Education MCP server for Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Drive, and Classroom — 29 tools in the README table, 31 tool names counting docs_import_hwp / docs_export_hwpx. README IS IN KOREAN and references Korean curriculum standards; HWP/HWPX are Korean national document formats. THE FIRST KOREAN-LANGUAGE EDUCATION AGENT THIS KB HAS PAYLOAD-VERIFIED. Grade it exactly as ai_tutor_forge was graded: LANGUAGE evidence, no country or institution stated.

column1: pengusto/google-classroom-mcp
column8: Payload carries TWO copyright lines: "Copyright (c) 2026 Adria Santacreu i Gimenez and contributors" AND "Copyright (c) 2026 Pengusto (modifications)". A correctly-attributed downstream fork of the row above — worth recording as the one piece of good licence hygiene in this family.

column1: alanmagno1/google-classroom-mcp
column8: ABOUT TEXT IS IN SPANISH ("Servidor MCP para Google Classroom: cursos, tareas pendientes, entregas y materiales desde Claude, con varias cuentas") BUT THE README IS IN ENGLISH. README uses a "unam" alias in examples; UNAM is not claimed as provenance because the page does not state it. This is METADATA-language evidence — weaker than the Portuguese ai_tutor_forge README. The Spanish gap is NOT retracted on it.

column1: OmarNiazi/classroom-mcp
column8: Read-only by construction: "it can't submit work, post, or change anything." README notes "Google hasn't verified this app." The right shape for a student-side pilot and the wrong shape for an institutional deliverable.

column1: praisethefacts/google-classroom-mcp
column8: Read-only access to courses, coursework, rosters, submissions for any MCP-capable agent.

column1: faizan45640/google-classroom-mcp-server
column8: Requests Classroom readonly scopes. Oldest copyright line in the family.

column1: AStheTECH/mewcp-google-classroom
column2: *** NOT OPEN SOURCE — "AStheTECH Community License (ACL) ... All rights reserved" (payload) ***
column8: SECOND INSTANCE OF THE PageLM PATTERN. Sat in the same search result set as the seven MIT rows above, described identically as a "Google Classroom MCP Server". A custom licence at LICENSE.md with an acceptance-of-terms clause and an all-rights-reserved header. NOT usable in a client deliverable. It passes p238's lure gate — it is not a fraud, it is simply NOT PERMISSIVE — which is exactly why the grant must be read and the gate is not a substitute for reading it.

column1: ## ---- A PERMISSIVE-PLATFORM CANDIDATE THAT IS NOT ONE ----
classroomio/classroomio
column8: A 2026-dated search result framed this as the open alternative to Moodle and edX. The payload is AGPL-3.0. CONSISTENT with open-gaps.md, which already carries this row as "AGPL core + MIT mcp package" and as the verified member of the OSI-GRANT-PLUS-KEY-GATE state (README: "Optional for self-hosted Enterprise-only features (SSO, token-auth, no-tracking): set LICENSE_KEY"). The permissive COMPLETE-PLATFORM count is UNCHANGED AT FIVE.
